create_GMModel: create a GMModel object with a GMParam configuration for global forecasting
train_GMModel: train the GMModel on time series data and return training loss information
predict_GMModel: generate forecasts for time series using the trained GMModel predict method
save_load_GMModel: save the GMModel to a pickle file or load it from a saved file
evaluate_GMModel: evaluate the GMModel performance on test data and return a DataFrame of metrics
